title: Session policy headroom: 30 characters under the 2048 STS limit
description: buildOwnerSessionPolicy packs to 2018 characters for the long-id fixture; each extra tenant id character costs about 7. Before more tenants or longer ids, shorten: one LeadingKeys list, fewer repeated statements, or use a role per computer for the static part. Guard: the existing size scenario with a realistic longest tenant id.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Triage 2026-10-14: closing as obsolete. buildOwnerSessionPolicy no longer exists on origin/develop (no match in conversation/, infra/ or features/). The credential broker (conversation/src/lambdas/owner-credential-broker.ts, PR 517 and 518) assumes ComputerOwnerScopedRole with session tags and NO session policy; features/owner_credential_broker.feature asserts 'the broker's assume-role call carries no session policy'. The permissions are a static policy file conversation/src/gateway/owner-role-policy.json written with IAM tag variables (docs/PI_SESSION_HANDOFF.md says the 2048 character session policy limit no longer applies). features/owner_role_policy.feature and supervisor_role_policy.feature judge the static policies.

right_now_summary: The session policy was removed and replaced with a static tagged role policy, so the 2048-character limit no longer
